extraction.Name: Clara Bonser Monteau
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded February 13, 1918 by C. L. Dice, but the date is not shown
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged by Clara Monteau and Enoch Monteau, her husband, for $1400.00 due in six months; then conveyed by warranty deed to David A. Hancock for $3,000
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612690; land described as northwest quarter of section 36, township 36, range 27; mortgage dated February 6, 1918 executed by Clara Monteau (formerly Bonser) and Enoch Monteau, her husband; receipt for patent signed by allottee; land conveyed February 20, 1918 by warranty deed signed by Clara Bonser Monteau and her husband to David A. Hancock
